g.text: Figure 16. (a) A flame of height H and a receiver (person) at distance d on flat ground; the published rule d = 4H (Butler and
Cohen 1998) keeps the radiant heat flux q″ reaching the receiver at or below 7 kW/m². (b) The computed safe separation
distance d* at 7 kW/m² in every burned cell of four reconstructed Korean fires (13,125 cells, baseline fuel; log count): 13,125
of 13,125 lie below one 375 m grid cell; the largest over every fuel level is 323 m (Uljin 2022, high fuel). On the replay's front
road cells the median is 25 m (7,644 cell-hours). Model output; no measured flux. Source: research/kcf-radiation.
